verdict.rationale: Evidence covers webhooks, an API/SDK reference, and embeddable widgets that let Featurebase content appear inside a customer's own product—but nothing shows developers building custom integrations that appear or operate inside Featurebase's own interface (e.g., an app marketplace, plugin panel, or in-app extension surface). Missing for 10: any documentation of a Featurebase-hosted app/plugin framework, in-product extension points, or examples of third-party integrations running within the Featurebase UI itself.
